// FORM 1 OF 3: a plain blocking Receive into a concrete struct, on a channel whose
// NAME a messageBus.deliverSignal producer uses.
//
// This is projectsupervision.go:48 exactly as it stood until stage 4b3 Task 2 — the
// LATENT instance, and the one an id-keyed gate would have cleared, because that
// name's two producers reach different execution ids.
//
// The file is .go.txt so the go tool never builds it. Nothing here needs to compile:
// the gate is AST-only, so `workflow` may be an undeclared package and the fixture is
// still a faithful statement of the shape.
package badreceive

const signalOperatorPauseRequested = "operatorPauseRequested"

type operatorPauseSignal struct {
	ProjectID string
	Reason    string
}

func BadReceive(ctx workflow.Context) string {
	ch := workflow.GetSignalChannel(ctx, signalOperatorPauseRequested)
	var sig operatorPauseSignal
	ch.Receive(ctx, &sig) // WANT: flagged — concrete struct target on a bus-delivered name
	return sig.Reason
}
